posts.name: Google EmbeddingGemma 2
posts.tagline: An open, lightweight multimodal embedding model
posts.description: EmbeddingGemma 2 is Google DeepMind's open embedding model that maps text, code, images, video and audio into one shared space, so you can search across them from a single query. At 740M parameters it runs on-device, needing about 567MB of RAM on a Pixel 11 Pro for the full multimodal model (191MB for text only). Apache 2.0 licensed, with weights on Hugging Face and Kaggle. MTEB Code score rises from 68.76 to 78.68.

posts.name: ngram 2.0
posts.tagline: Create explainers, screencasts, and AI avatar videos
posts.description: Turn ideas, documents, and recordings into narrated videos. ngram analyzes uploaded videos and screen recordings to identify key moments and build clear product walkthroughs. Create animated explainers or add an AI avatar presenter, then refine your video in chat.

posts.name: Knocket
posts.tagline: Chat with visitors from your website or link
posts.description: Makers need a way for visitors to reach them, and to reply without opening another dashboard. Paste one script tag and a chat bubble appears on any site, or publish a contact page for your bio. Visitors start typing with no account needed. Messages go to Telegram. Quote-reply and it appears on their screen, and the thread stays in your inbox. If you're away, they leave an email. An AI agent answers from your docs and hands off to you when it matters. Free, no credit card, live in minutes.

posts.name: Base Code
posts.tagline: Let your whole team build on your product
posts.description: Base Code lets teams work directly on existing codebases from the browser. Connect GitHub, describe changes in plain language, preview them live, and send completed work through standard pull requests.

posts.name: guilds.run
posts.tagline: Create multi-agent workflows that you can trust
posts.description: Open-source AI agent teams you can actually inspect. Debug every prompt, tool call, memory change, and agent interaction. Control permissions, edit context, and choose the model for each agent. Self-host for free. Stop guessing what your agents are doing.

posts.name: Manifold MCP
posts.tagline: SEO, AI answers, social, ads and leads data for your agent
posts.description: Manifold gives your agent live data from every marketing channel, in one hosted MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Claude Code. Find keywords one push from page one. See if ChatGPT and Gemini recommend you. Watch the TikToks winning your niche. Read your competitors’ live ads. Catch Reddit threads asking for what you make. Get verified emails for buyers looking right now. Ask in plain words and your agent does the work. No pile of tabs. Free to start.

posts.name: Ancher 2.0
posts.tagline: Turn everything you read and save into work you can ship
posts.description: Ancher is an AI knowledge workspace that turns everything you read, watch, and save into work you can actually use. Capture articles, videos, PDFs, posts, and ideas without organizing folders. Ancher connects related knowledge, lets you search and ask questions across your sources, and helps turn what you've learned into research briefs, reports, presentations, and content in your own voice. Your saved knowledge becomes more useful every time you add to it.

posts.name: Hexis Cloud
posts.tagline: One company brain for all your AI agents
posts.description: Hexis is one company brain for your team and all its AI agents. Through Hexis, your team can align on shared context that's important to align on, non-technical teams can work and collaborate on skills and your team can have hundreds of tools accessible via one MCP gateway. All the information is owned by someone, meaning it's context you can trust, and Hexis enables access control to a single file. It only takes a few minutes to set up, and is free for up to 3 people. Would love your feedback!

posts.name: Kudos 3.0
posts.tagline: The AI that finds money you're missing and gets it back
posts.description: Most money apps show you charts. Kudos does the work. Your home shows Your wins, one number for everything Kudos has earned or saved you, and your next best money move. Most people don't know their cards come with personalized offers they have to turn on by hand. Kudos activates them for you: about $800/yr in offers in early testing. Our AI also calls providers to lower your bills ($216/yr per negotiation) and cancels subscriptions you forgot ($247/yr each). You keep 100% of the savings.

posts.name: Scrape Anything by Context.dev
posts.tagline: Turn any website into clean data with one API call.
posts.description: Scrape Anything by Context lets you pull clean, usable data from the web without building or maintaining scraping infrastructure. Give Context a URL and it handles rendering, blocks, proxies, retries, and extraction—returning Markdown, HTML, screenshots, or structured data through one API.

posts.name: Bearconnect 2.0
posts.tagline: AI-Powered LinkedIn Platform for Content and Outreach
posts.description: Bearconnect started as a LinkedIn outreach tool. With V2, it’s now a platform for both inbound and outbound on LinkedIn. Create and schedule content, find prospects from LinkedIn activity, and turn intent into conversations with AI-powered messaging. V2 also adds team workspaces, role-based access, Brand Voice, CRM integrations, and webhooks.

posts.name: Dropstone CLI
posts.tagline: The self-learning coding agent for your terminal
posts.description: Dropstone CLI is a coding agent that learns from you. It reads your repo, edits across files, runs commands and tests, and checks its work before it says it's done. Correct it once and it keeps the lesson across sessions. Pick Fast, Pro, or Heavy models, plan before it builds, and set which commands run, ask first, or are blocked. Add skills, custom agents, parallel subagents, and MCP tools. Comment on a GitHub issue and it opens a pull request. On every plan, including Free.

posts.name: Invited - AI Reminder Scanner
posts.tagline: AI reminder scanner for bills, invites & documents
posts.description: Invited is an AI reminder scanner that turns bills, invitations, cheques, screenshots and PDFs into smart reminders. It extracts dates, times, places and amounts, supports 80+ languages and 9 calendars, and finds multiple reminders in one document.

posts.name: ExcaliClaw
posts.tagline: Hand-drawn diagrams your AI agent can draw with you
posts.description: ExcaliClaw is a collaborative workspace for hand-drawn diagrams. Organize them in collections, search instantly, share by link or by name, and draw together in real time. Its MCP server lets Claude, Cursor or VS Code create and edit diagrams for you. Generous free plan: 200 drawings and unlimited AI (MCP) use, no credit card. Paid plans from €9/month. Version history, trash and backup export included. English, Español, Français.

posts.name: Milepost
posts.tagline: An iOS driving journal for your car, with an MCP server
posts.description: Milepost is a driving journal for your car on iOS, with an MCP server for ChatGPT, Claude, and other compatible AI agents. Record routes, photos, notes, music, and moments in Roadbooks. Share with friends for reactions and comments, or send a public web link. Build your garage, collect city and state stamps in each car’s Stampbook, relive routes in 3D, and make animated shares and monthly recaps. Record for free; Pro unlocks older history, exports, and deeper insights.

posts.name: SquadRoom
posts.tagline: AI employees that work 24/7
posts.description: SquadRoom gives you a team of AI employees. A lead agent learns your company and plans the work. Specialists for research, writing, partnerships and operations do it. You drop a task on the board and walk away. When you come back, the work is finished and a report shows every step and every source. Agents only stop to ask you when a decision really needs you, and nothing goes out without your OK. Bring your own AI key. Try the live demo, no signup.

posts.name: Understory Notes
posts.tagline: Notes that tell the tale
posts.description: Understory is a Mac notes app for people who take notes in order to write something. Collect notes as you read, arrange them into an outline, and draft each section with your research beside it. Then publish as a PDF, Rich Text, Markdown or a website.

posts.name: SalesRep.com
posts.tagline: Your AI sales rep: live prices, quotes & follow-ups 24/7
posts.description: SalesRep is a virtual sales rep that sells for you 24/7. Pulls live prices & stock from Shopify, WooCommerce, PrestaShop, Meta Catalog or your own database/API • Answers on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, email, SMS and more • Sends product cards and quotes on the fly, in any channel • Follows up until the deal closes, with human takeover anytime • 30+ languages, auto-detected Full-featured from $39/mo. 21-day free trial, no credit card required.

posts.name: Cube Forms
posts.tagline: Forms that can be filled by agents
posts.description: Cube forms are made for AI agents. Your agent can create a form and fill one in directly, over MCP or plain HTTP, from Claude Code, ChatGPT, Cursor or any agent. No browser, no CAPTCHA. People can still open the same link and step in anytime: check what the agent filled, change anything, or fill it themselves. Free. Sign-ups, waitlists, bug reports, sales inquiries, any form.

posts.name: Codemind
posts.tagline: Delegate coding. Get back code that works.
posts.description: Your coding agent hands Codemind a task over MCP. It writes the code, tests it against your criteria and returns the files. $0.10 per verified build, failed builds free, free allowance to start.

posts.name: WPMaven
posts.tagline: Create and run your business with AI
posts.description: Describe any business. WPMaven creates it, runs it and grows it. A bakery, a coaching practice, a studio: in minutes you get the brand, the website, the offer and prices, then an AI team runs it every week with posts, videos and a Monday report. Nothing goes out without your yes on WhatsApp. Free to try. Launch day only: our team sets up your business with you, at no extra cost.

posts.name: Maya Tutor
posts.tagline: AI private tutor that turns homework into a magical game
posts.description: Maya is an AI private tutor for kids. Tell her what they're learning at school and she turns every lesson into a magical, playful world. Math, reading, science and English by grade level, in 11 languages. Free to start, no credit card, no ads.

posts.name: Momentra
posts.tagline: Event data infrastructure for community calendars
posts.description: Momentra is community event data infrastructure for products that need fresh public events. It finds events across trusted organizations, resolves identities, reconciles conflicting details, tracks changes and provenance, and maintains a structured event database accessible through an events API. Instead of treating event aggregation as a one-time scraping job, Momentra keeps the underlying information current as it changes.

posts.name: Linkstore
posts.tagline: The App Store for Web
posts.description: Discover web apps worth opening. New tools, games and experiments every week, reviewed by people before they're listed.

posts.name: ClassQuip
posts.tagline: A modern, browser-native virtual classroom for K-12
posts.description: ClassQuip is the browser-native virtual classroom engineered for K-12. Built on a proprietary WebRTC media engine with custom TURN and signaling infrastructure, ClassQuip brings interactive decks, real-time polls, 1-click breakouts, and automated attendance logging into a single tab. Powered by built-in PII-stripping AI, teachers get instant lesson generation that is 100% FERPA and COPPA safe.

posts.name: carcode
posts.tagline: Talk to Claude Code from your car, with Siri and CarPlay
posts.description: Say "Hey Siri, Jarvis" and Claude Code on your Mac checks PRs, CI, Slack and email, or makes a small fix as a draft PR, while CarPlay reads the answer aloud. No app, no API key. It asks before sending or merging anything. Free and open source.

posts.name: ProductOS
posts.tagline: From idea to shipped product, with AI agents.
posts.description: ProductOS takes a product from idea to launch. AI agents research the market, write the PRD, design the brand and screens, build real code in a cloud sandbox and publish it to your own domain. You approve every stage. Websites, web apps and mobile apps. Every project gets a GitHub repo, a live preview and one-click publish to Vercel. Use it from Cursor or Claude Code over MCP. Free plan includes 200 credits.

posts.name: Shotie
posts.tagline: App Store screenshots, made by chatting with AI
posts.description: A Mac app that makes App Store and Google Play screenshots by chatting with the AI you already use. Export every store language in one zip. Screenshots are rendered locally on your Mac, using your own AI account. Built for Apple's product page A/B testing. Requires macOS 26.

posts.name: SkillFoundry
posts.tagline: Your best engineer couldn't pass your own interview
posts.description: Algorithm puzzles test memorization, and AI can solve them anyway. SkillFoundry gives candidates a real task in a real open-source codebase, with an AI assistant at their side, and measures how they work. Sometimes that assistant is wrong on purpose: we plant a subtle flaw in a suggestion and tell you whether the candidate caught it or shipped it. You get a hiring report with timestamped evidence, not a pass/fail score.

posts.name: Talentlo
posts.tagline: Rank every candidate against each other, not just the JD
posts.description: Many AI screeners score each resume alone against the JD. Talentlo’s MARK model also compares every candidate with every other candidate, so you get a true relative ranking of your applicant pool. It remembers your JD context and tracks each candidate through the hiring process. Built for Indian SMBs and tech teams; data hosted on AWS Mumbai and Hyderabad, DPDP-aligned.

posts.name: Flagfolio
posts.tagline: Every country you visit. One passport to show it.
posts.description: Flagfolio is a free digital travel passport that turns your adventures into something you can collect and share. Add a flag for every country you've visited, celebrate your travel milestones, and create a visual record of your journey. Share your passport with friends or show it off on social media. No account required. Start collecting your flags and see where your travels take you next.

posts.name: Lavvi
posts.tagline: Never hold it in again.
posts.description: Lavvi helps you find public washrooms and check their cleanliness and usability before you visit. Whether you're travelling, exploring a new city, or out for the day, Lavvi makes it easier to find a washroom when you need one. Our goal is to make access to public washrooms less stressful through community-powered information.

posts.name: Brexy Studio
posts.tagline: Give every dealmaker an AI deal team
posts.description: Brexy Agents Studio is a Slack-style workspace where AI agents work with each other and with you. Assign work in a channel, agents hand off tasks through a team lead, and you approve every step. Hundreds of agents, Dozens of AI teams, built for capital markets.

posts.name: Day Zero
posts.tagline: Fund and validate SaaS ideas. Back & trade lifetime deals.
posts.description: Most crowdfunding platforms aren't built for software, and standard launch platforms make it too easy to just "like" a startup. Day Zero bridges this gap by letting founders get their first 100 customers before they even have a product. You can pre-sell licenses to fund and validate your MVP from day zero, while giving backers a completely new asset class: tradable lifetime deals.

posts.name: LoadLoom — Every Load. Accounted For.
posts.tagline: Every Load. Accounted For.
posts.description: Dispatch and operations software for sand, M-Sand, aggregate and brick suppliers. Orders, trucks, deliveries, invoices and payments in one place.

posts.name: VandraQuest
posts.tagline: Plan the trip, track the excursions, share the story
posts.description: VandraQuest is a travel command center. Describe a trip in plain English and an AI copilot builds the itinerary. Forward your booking confirmations and they file themselves into the right trip. Every flight is tracked live, with gate changes and delays pushed to your phone. Navigate each day, keep a travel log with photos, and share the finished trip as a story card so friends can copy it. Free today, no card required. iOS, Android and web.

posts.name: Ingresso Impresso
posts.tagline: Copy-proof printed tickets with offline QR check-in
posts.description: Generate numbered paper tickets with signed QR codes, print them at home or at a print shop, and scan them at the door with any phone, even offline. Copies and photos are blocked on the second scan. First 30 tickets free, then pay per batch. No subscription.

posts.name: OmuType
posts.tagline: Cantonese voice keyboard that keeps your English words
posts.description: OmuType is an Android keyboard designed for how people in Hong Kong actually communicate: mixing Cantonese and English in the same sentence. Unlike conventional voice typing that may misinterpret this mix, OmuType preserves colloquial Cantonese, keeps English words intact, and types in Hong Kong Traditional Chinese. It also offers voice corrections and multiple input methods. Typing is free, with 10 minutes of free voice typing per week.

posts.name: SheetApp.ai
posts.tagline: Check your sales lead CSV before it reaches your CRM
posts.description: Upload a CSV to find duplicate contacts, invalid emails, missing fields, and lead scores from 0 to 100 before you import data into your CRM or start outreach.

posts.name: Perigee
posts.tagline: Real-time web viewer of artificial objects in space
posts.description: See every active satellite around the Earth, the spacecraft orbiting the Moon and Mars, and the probes crossing the solar system, in real time and in 3D. Positions computed in your browser from public data (CelesTrak, NASA/JPL Horizons). English and French.

posts.name: JD Mock Interview by AllthingsPM
posts.tagline: Paste a job description, get a scored PM mock interview
posts.description: Paste any product manager job description and get a mock interview built around that exact role, company and level. Answer by typing or out loud with voice, get follow-up questions like a real panel, then a scored breakdown on the competencies interviewers actually weigh. One free mock a day.

posts.name: Moni
posts.tagline: A storybook period tracker you can share with your partner
posts.description: Most period trackers give you a chart. Moni gives you a storybook: every day of your cycle is a painted page with what's happening in your body, what helps today, and a note from Moni. Draw on it, add stickers, or ask Moni anything; she knows where you are in your cycle. Invite a partner, parent or friend: they get the day's mood and one real way to help, never your dates or symptoms. Free on iPhone and the web. Pro adds chat and daily check-ins.

posts.name: Notify
posts.tagline: Stop managing tasks. Start living in flow.
posts.description: Notify is a reminder app that speaks up at the right place, not just the right time. Get nudged when you arrive at or leave somewhere: the store, the gym, home. Build checklists, share them in Circles with family or roommates, and add tasks by voice. Native on Android and iOS, free to start with an optional Notify Plus. Stop checking your lists. Let your lists find you.

posts.name: Kinhin
posts.tagline: Turn your Mac into an autoscaling CI runner pool
posts.description: The mindful CI — autoscaling CI runners that live on your Mac. macOS jobs on Tart VMs, Linux jobs on apple/container microVMs or Docker.

posts.name: Quotra
posts.tagline: Know where your money goes and what's coming next
posts.description: Most budget apps show where your money went. Quotra helps you see what's ahead, too. Track spending and income, manage accounts, plan budgets, and see what's safe to spend. Keep subscriptions and upcoming bills in view, or share a budget with your partner or family. A simpler, more visual way to manage everyday money — without connecting your bank.

posts.name: Quantral
posts.tagline: Investment ideas app built on alternative data
posts.description: Quantral is an investment ideas app built on alternative data. It tracks what finance X, Reddit, YouTube and Substack are saying, what members of Congress are trading, and which company insiders are buying their own stock. Every company gets a 0-100 score, and every voice making a call gets graded on their real track record. Strategies turn the same data into model portfolios you can follow and compare against the S&P 500. On iPhone, Android, the web, and inside Claude and ChatGPT.

posts.name: SubmitLists
posts.tagline: Find the right places to launch, list, & grow your business.
posts.description: Your startup deserves more than a random list of directories. SubmitLists helps you find the best places to submit your startup, SaaS, AI tool, agency, or local business. Explore hand-selected directories and launch platforms, compare traffic, domain authority, and link types, and prioritize opportunities that fit your goals. Spend less time researching and more time getting discovered. Free to use. No paywall.

posts.name: jitllm
posts.tagline: An operating system for LLM inference
posts.description: One binary. No dependencies. Drop it in and run. Up to 4.62x faster prefill than llama.cpp and 5.53x faster batched decoding than vLLM. jitllm detects your hardware and optimizes kernels and model placement across CPUs and GPUs. Run open-weight flagships, even larger than memory. OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, desktop and terminal apps. Linux, macOS and Windows.

posts.name: Bobbin
posts.tagline: The missing memory for your AI
posts.description: The missing memory for your AI. Bobbin privately captures what you browse and read, so your AI assistant knows it too. Free.

posts.name: ImageCompressor
posts.tagline: Compress images, then let your AI agent do it too
posts.description: Compress, resize, convert and clean up images in your browser. Every tool is also a REST API, an SDK and an MCP server, so scripts and AI agents can use them. Scan a whole website and fix its heavy images. No ads. Free to start.

posts.name: TryTestimonials
posts.tagline: Real customer proof on your website, in minutes.
posts.description: A testimonial collector for small businesses, coaches and freelancers. Send one link, approve what comes back, and show a wall of customer quotes on any website.

posts.name: LocalSheet
posts.tagline: Free, private spreadsheets that work offline
posts.description: LocalSheet is a free spreadsheet editor that keeps your files on your device. Create sheets or import CSV/XLSX files, edit and format cells, use formulas and dropdowns, and drag-select ranges for quick Sum, Average, Count, Min and Max. Export XLSX, CSV or PDF. Local autosave and offline support keep everyday spreadsheet work simple, with no account required.

posts.name: DivineAI
posts.tagline: Voice-first spiritual and wellness AI in your language
posts.description: DivineAI is a voice-first spiritual and wellness companion that talks with you in your own language. Ask a spiritual question, find a puja, learn about a temple or plan a yatra, by speaking or typing, with verified temple information behind the answers. Part of the DharmikVibes ecosystem for devotees in India and abroad.

posts.name: FormFlow
posts.tagline: Form backend that keeps the leads your form refused
posts.description: Point any HTML form at one URL. FormFlow receives, filters, stores and forwards each submission. When your own settings turn a real person away, it keeps the submission and names the one setting change that would win the most of them back.

posts.name: Keywork
posts.tagline: Paid AI training roles, updated daily, matched to you
posts.description: AI companies pay engineers, scientists, clinicians and linguists by the hour to review what their models produce. Keywork lists about 1,300 open roles from nine platforms, removes the ones that close, and shows you the ones that fit your languages and field. Free.

posts.name: dropctl
posts.tagline: Share any file in seconds. No signup, it expires itself.
posts.description: dropctl is a free, no-signup file sharing tool. Upload a file or a bundle of files and get a short link plus a QR code. Choose your own slug, set an expiry up to 7 days (default 24h), and the file is cleaned up automatically. Multi-file uploads are zipped in your browser, and the recipient can pick which files to download.

posts.name: React Image Editor Source Code
posts.tagline: A production-ready, graphic and photo editor!
posts.description: 🎨 Canvas Studio Pro — In-Browser Image Editor (React 19 + Vite) Save 120+ hours of dev time! Production-ready photo & graphic editor built with React 19, Vite & Pure CSS. Zero heavy canvas dependencies (no Fabric.js). ✨ Features: • Proportional resize, rotation & multi-ratio crop • 16+ live filters, film grain, vector shapes & text • Layers, snapping, smooth pan/zoom (10%-500%) • High-res PNG/JPEG export +json projects 100% client-side & 129 tests. Ready to embed in your SaaS!

posts.name: Share Artifacts
posts.tagline: Create and share presentations with your own AI agent
posts.description: Turn your notes into HTML presentations, reports and visual explainers with the AI agent you already use. Reuse saved styles and templates, publish a shareable link, control who can open it, and update the same URL.

posts.name: Uplitycs
posts.tagline: Cookieless analytics, uptime checks & a status page
posts.description: Cookieless analytics, uptime monitoring and a public status page in one dashboard. One script under 1kb, no cookies, no profile of each visitor. Free for 1 website, no card needed.

posts.name: Phone Number Formatter by FreeWWW
posts.tagline: Validate & format phone numbers for 190+ countries
posts.description: A free phone number formatter covering 190+ countries. Pick a country to see its number format, an example and international dialing instructions, then paste your own number to validate and auto-format it in real time. Numbers starting with + are matched to their country automatically, and one click copies the result in international, E.164 or national format. No signup, no limits, plus dark mode.

posts.name: dropctl
posts.tagline: Share any file in seconds. No signup, it expires itself.
posts.description: dropctl is a free, no-signup file sharing tool. Upload a file or a bundle of files and get a short link plus a QR code. Choose your own slug, set an expiry up to 7 days (default 24h), and the file is cleaned up automatically. Multi-file uploads are zipped in your browser, and the recipient can pick which files to download.

posts.name: overOne
posts.tagline: A month of viral reels for your SaaS in 1 minute
posts.description: You built the product. overOne gets it seen. Enter your website and get a daily feed of ready-to-post reels and image posts made for your brand. Scroll, tweak, and post to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and more at once. Replies and DMs run on autopilot.

posts.name: UX HeatGrid
posts.tagline: See what stands out. Record how it is used.
posts.description: UX HeatGrid shows your page two ways, right from Chrome's side panel. Predict ranks every button and link High, Medium or Low from size, position, contrast and nearby competition, with no recording needed. Record captures your own session and paints clicks, pointer heat and scroll depth exactly where they happened. Every result shows its reasons and highlights the element on the live page. No accounts, servers or tracking.

posts.name: CrossZero
posts.tagline: Real-time multiplayer tic-tac-toe on massive grids.
posts.description: Think you know Tic-Tac-Toe? CrossZero scales the classic game into a high-stakes tactical battlefield. The match doesn't end at 3-in-a-row—you play the entire board (up to 10x10). Complete multi-triplet combos for points until the grid is full. Features real-time global multiplayer, 7 ELO ranks (Bronze to Grandmaster), private rooms with friends, and calibrated AI bots. Master the grid and outsmart the world!

posts.name: raceto10
posts.tagline: You said you'd get customers Now prove it in public for free
posts.description: RaceTo10 is a free, public 7-day challenge for indie hackers and SaaS founders starting from zero paying customers Connect Stripe with a restricted key, race toward your first 10 paying customers, and let people follow your verified customer count on a public leaderboard Your key is encrypted and deleted when your race ends. No self-reported screenshots just a challenge to build traction in public Join the race: https://www.raceto10.lol/

posts.name: Make Me A Movie
posts.tagline: Type one sentence, get a finished short film
posts.description: Make Me a Movie is an AI film studio. Type one sentence, get a finished short film, on the web or inside Claude and ChatGPT (developer mode). It writes the script, films each scene, adds narration and music, and cuts it. Pay per film, no subscription.

posts.name: APX Terminal 7.2
posts.tagline: One app where AI teammates do your work, across your tools
posts.description: Most AI tools answer questions. APX Terminal does the work. Hire AI teammates with a role, hand them tasks in plain words, and they work across your files, apps and 100 tools: reports, replies, documents, websites, data and servers. Nothing changes until you approve it. New in 7.2: Infra maps your infrastructure down to the network, Test has AI click through your web app and record every step, Env keeps 260 dev tools current. Bring your own Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini plan.

posts.name: Kept
posts.tagline: Make a promise. Keep a record.
posts.description: Kept is a free Android app for personal promises. Start with something concrete, like "Read two pages." Choose the days you want to follow through, add a short note when you finish, and look back at completed and missed promises. A simple way to keep a record of what you set out to do and what actually happened.

posts.name: Corpus
posts.tagline: Harvest excerpts from your corpus (without AI flattening)
posts.description: LLMs notoriously struggle with citing sources and tend to flatten when they mix sources and provide general summaries. There's a better way for simply recalling your own corpus. With Corpus, you can upload files within projects and search for excerpts. The search matches semantically, making it more powerful than typical searches but more focused than LLMs.

posts.name: Taim.io
posts.tagline: Your personal learning coach for any skill
posts.description: Tell Taim.io what you want to learn. Your personal coach teaches you through short, interactive lessons, checks your understanding, and gives specific feedback on your practice. Improve your answers and pick up where you left off. Start free, no account needed.

posts.name: microPMS
posts.tagline: Property Management Software
posts.description: A simple mobile-first workspace for rental calendars, bookings, pricing and direct inquiries.

posts.name: Webfetch.io - Web Scraping API & MCP
posts.tagline: Drop in Scrapingbee API alternative with rates 38-40% less
posts.description: Webfetch by Tuxxin LLC delivers full web scraping power at ~40% lower cost than ScrapingBee. It is 100% parameter-compatible: migrate your existing scrapers and AI pipelines immediately by changing only your endpoint and API key. Key features: • Dynamic JS rendering & proxy rotation • Outputs rendered HTML, Markdown, or clean JSON • Built for AI/LLM pipelines and high-volume scraping Stop overpaying for data extraction. Same scraping reliability, 40% more margin.

posts.name: Melodic Sampler
posts.tagline: Turn recordings and samples into playable musical ideas
posts.description: Turn a sound into an instrument. Record or import samples, edit the source, build sampler racks, and layer sounds into beats and textures. Shape playback with dynamic sampling controls and effects, then record and export sampled clips for your next production. Melodic Sampler is built for beatmakers, sound designers and live experimentation on web, iOS and Android. Start with free features and unlock more through optional paid upgrades.

posts.name: Origin Tech
posts.tagline: List your dev tool for free, or get a short video about it
posts.description: Origin Tech is a launch directory for dev tools and AI products, run by a tech explainer channel with 1.5M+ views on TikTok. - Free listings, reviewed by hand, each with a real write-up - Browse by category, compare tools side by side, follow new launches by RSS - Want more reach? Book a 30-60s short in the channel's style, posted to TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Instagram and clearly labelled as sponsored

posts.name: Vibe Shift
posts.tagline: Slack messages that always land right
posts.description: Vibe Shift is your Slack communication companion, ensuring your messages land the right way, every time. Whether you need to sound professional, casual, friendly, concise, or more. It rewrites your message in seconds, without leaving Slack. Just type a slash command with your rough draft and Vibe Shift handles the rest. You can also use /reply to generate a context-aware reply based on recent channel messages. And with custom writing rules in your settings, it learns to write the way you do.

posts.name: Educket
posts.tagline: Any idea you keep nodding along to, explained in 5 min
posts.description: Educket explains the ideas everyone keeps mentioning (AI agents, RAG, credit scores, unit economics) in about 5 minutes. Each lesson gives you one picture you won't forget and real cases to try the idea on, then asks you to explain it back in your own words, so you know you actually get it. 300+ lessons across AI, money, business and security, each designed and reviewed by people. Pro members can request any missing topic. Free to try with no sign-up. On iPhone today, Android next.

posts.name: Insika
posts.tagline: The decisioning engine for modern marketing
posts.description: Insika turns fragmented marketing and market data into forward-looking intelligence. Track competitors in real time, forecast demand shifts, and get AI-recommended next-best actions with optimal budget allocation, then execute across web and paid media.

posts.name: Mind Solutions
posts.tagline: The most effective learning method made more effective!
posts.description: We generate Anki-compatible flashcards for any purpose you need. Upload notes, get a ready deck.

posts.name: DLTK.io
posts.tagline: DLTK is a free TikTok video downloader
posts.description: DLTK is a free TikTok video downloader that removes watermarks automatically. Download TikTok videos in HD quality, convert to MP3, or save thumbnails - all in one place. No app needed, no registration required. Fast, simple, and works on all devices.

posts.name: Oktoprism
posts.tagline: Ship your startup in days, not weeks
posts.description: The production ready Next.js SaaS starter with everything you need to get your product in front of customers. From idea to production in 10 minutes.

posts.name: MyPetHQ
posts.tagline: Book trusted pet sitters, walkers & groomers in one app
posts.description: MyPetHQ connects pet owners with trusted local pet sitters, dog walkers, and groomers — all in one app. Unlike marketplaces that just list providers, MyPetHQ gives independent sitters and multi-person pet care businesses real tools: scheduling, invoicing, team management, waitlists, and secure in-app messaging. Clients get real-time updates and photo check-ins during every visit. Built for solo sitters and growing pet care businesses alike.

posts.name: AgentTaste
posts.tagline: Production-tested SKILL.md packages  for agent
posts.description: Production-tested SKILL.md packages and system rules for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf & Antigravity. Elevate AI code with Linear dark UI and clean architecture.

posts.name: DiscordTextLab
posts.tagline: 100+ Free Discord Bio Templates, Live Profile Simulator
posts.description: 500+ Free Discord Bio Templates, Live Profile Simulator with 190-character limit counter, Aesthetic Fonts, Symbols, and Discord ANSI Text Formatter.

posts.name: webtamo.com
posts.tagline: The simplest way to get a website
posts.description: Answer a few questions about your business. Get a finished, custom website back, every page written and designed for you, ready to put online with its own web address. Free to start. No credit card before you see it.

posts.name: Finlyzers
posts.tagline: Convert PDF and scanned bank statements into Exce
posts.description: Convert PDF and scanned bank statements to Excel, CSV, QBO, OFX or QIF. OCR extracts every transaction and checks it against the balance. Free up to 10 pages.

posts.name: deskNode
posts.tagline: The AI desk companion: in your Mac's notch and on your desk
posts.description: deskNode is an AI desk companion. On your Mac, it lives in the notch: ask about anything on screen and it reads the exact text, then runs commands, files things, books meetings or draws diagrams, asking before anything risky. Tasks, notes, calendar, focus timer, music and Claude Code sessions sit there too. On your desk, the deskNode device (in prototype) shows your timer, next meeting and alerts, with one dial for focus, music and macros. Mac app: Apple Silicon.

posts.name: AbaAiCheck
posts.tagline: AI Session Notes Generator for ABA Therapy (EHR Agnostic)
posts.description: AbaAiCheck is an EHR-agnostic Chrome extension that helps BCBAs and RBTs draft, audit, and review ABA session notes in real-time using AI. It works directly inside your current ABA therapy EHR. Ensure CPT and Medicaid compliance effortlessly before saving your notes. We provide Signed BAA, end-to-end encryption, and full audit logs for strict HIPAA compliance.

posts.name: Call Screener
posts.tagline: Answers unknown calls, blocks spam, rings you for real ones
posts.description: Call Screener is an AI assistant that answers the calls you don't pick up. It finds out who is calling and why, then rings you only for the ones you'd want. Spam and sales calls never ring your phone. Spam filters label a call and leave the decision to you. Silencing unknown callers means missing the school, the lab results, the delivery. This sits in between. You keep your number and your carrier. Set rules for who always rings through. Works on any carrier with call forwarding.

posts.name: MITA? 見た？ — your anime watch log
posts.tagline: Build for tracking your anime Wishlist
posts.description: I'm building it as 「見た？」(MITA? — "Have you seen it?"), a Japanese-poster-styled watch log with cream paper, ink, and vermillion — manga panel borders, hanko stamps, halftone textures, and a nagging TV mascot named TV-kun whose entire job is asking "Hey… have you watched [anime] yet?" until you do.

posts.name: Soborro Research
posts.tagline: Manage risk with confidence.
posts.description: Assess potential portfolio gains and losses across changing economic conditions with Soborro's Portfolio Risk Profiler. Start your analysis.

posts.name: NextStop.city
posts.tagline: Drop into a random city’s streets and catch the local vibe.
posts.description: I built nextstop.city to inspire people to travel and help them discover places they might never have considered. Just spin the 3D globe, pick a spot, and instantly drop into a POV street video synced with a live local radio station. It’s a simple, immersive way to get a true "feel" for an unknown city's culture and daily rhythm before you ever book a ticket.

posts.name: Pregnancy Due Date Calculator
posts.tagline: Due date, kick counter & contraction timer in one
posts.description: A free pregnancy companion that goes beyond a basic due date calculator. Calculate your due date from LMP, conception, IVF/FET transfer or ultrasound, with twin and triplet support. Then track baby’s week-by-week development, see upcoming appointments and tests, count kicks, time contractions with the 5-1-1 rule and tick off a hospital bag checklist. No signup, no app download. Estimates only; always consult your doctor.

posts.name: Piixpal
posts.tagline: Add animated pixel characters to any website
posts.description: A free, open-source library of animated pixel characters. They crawl on your headings, nap on your paragraphs, perch on your buttons and bounce on your footer. One script tag.

posts.name: TeamWheels
posts.tagline: Employee carpooling, right inside Microsoft Teams
posts.description: TeamWheels is employee carpooling that lives inside Microsoft Teams. No new app: it's an AI agent in the chat your colleagues already use. Say "I'm driving to the office Tuesday at 8am, 3 seats" to publish a ride, or "Anyone going home tonight?" to get matches by route and time with one-tap join requests. Confirmations and 24h/1h reminders land in chat and the Teams activity feed. Helps cut parking demand, commute costs and Scope 3 commute emissions. English, French, Spanish.

posts.name: Kinisma Studio
posts.tagline: The AI video studio you talk to, about $1 a minute
posts.description: Describe the video you need and Kinisma's agent makes it: it researches, writes the script, shows you a storyboard, then animates every scene with voiceover and music. Explainers, product demos, branded ads from a folder of your assets, shorts, tutorials and stick-figure stories. The AI plans, your computer renders, so a finished minute costs about $1 and "make it shorter" is nearly free. Free to start, 3 videos a month.

posts.name: enclose.dev
posts.tagline: An open-source workbench for CAD made with agents.
posts.description: Bring your own subscription. Fork it and make it yours. With AI rapidly learning how to output 3d models, I feel like we need an app that standardize fast iterations, per-chat versioning, custom tools and interactions per-project and files ready to print! It’s not a full-CAD app yet. I’ve been focusing on UI/AI first and then iterate on editable mode.

posts.name: Femkampshjälpen
posts.tagline: Play pentathlon at Scandinavian theme parks
posts.description: Femkampshjälpen is the scorekeeper for amusement park pentathlon (know as femkamp or 5-kamp). Track rounds, teams and points directly on your phone. Choose to play at a Scandinavian parks like Liseberg, Gröna Lund, Tivoli, or Bakken, to be able to select from all their current events. Free to download on iPhone and Android. No account needed.

posts.name: CleanTextAI
posts.tagline: Free private text cleans to strip formatting/PDF line breaks
posts.description: CleanTextAI.online is a free, 100% server-less formatting cleaner built for modern workflows. Unlike older tools that send text to external databases, it processes documents entirely inside your browser memory using local JavaScript for total privacy. In one click, users can repair jagged PDF line breaks, strip messy ChatGPT/Claude markdown asterisks, and eliminate double spacing. It is the ultimate ad-free, secure space for remote workers, data clerks, and writers.

posts.name: Trade Advisory Calculator
posts.tagline: Trade advisory on Stable and competitive company.
posts.description: In the era of unpredictably turbulent market, Trade advisory calculator evaluates firm thoroughly for its stability and competitiveness against peers based on multiple financial indicators. Predicting buy/sell indicators to beat the inflation and risk free rates. To help build portfolio that is low risk and optimal returns(more than inflation+risk free rate) to make your money grow actually.

posts.name: NextCommerce
posts.tagline: Full-stack eCommerce platform built with Next.js
posts.description: NextCommerce is a full-stack eCommerce platform built with Next.js. It includes a customer storefront and admin dashboard for managing products, categories, orders, customers, and store settings. Features include flexible product variants, galleries, cart and order management, Stripe, PayPal and Cash on Delivery, internationalization, responsive design, and a Supabase-powered backend. Built as a practical foundation for developers creating real online stores.
